title: Baton ticket — entry frontmatter
description: A Baton ticket's frontmatter: the work-item keys Baton's ticket source reads (status, depends_on, order, tags, prs, repos). `status: done` is legal only in the archive. Tickets moved from the immediately.run docs roadmap keep their R3-NNNN ids; new tickets are B-n.

itemId.description: A ticket id: B-n for tickets filed here, or the R3-NNN id a ticket kept when it moved from the immediately.run docs roadmap (with an optional split suffix, R3-51a, R3-274e1).
